messages:
alex: Heads-up — I merged a small change to the TS client streaming fallback earlier and noticed failing rerank/embed integration tests in main. Looks like some embeddings are coming back with an extra value (vector length is off by 1). Repro and logs below. 

alex: Repro (py):
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='redact')
e = c.embeddings.create(model='openvec-v1', input='hello')
print(len(e.embedding))  # 769 but should be 768
```

ci-bot: nightly-embed-tests FAILED on main — rerank_integration (log: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345) :warning:

maria: @alex :eyes: can you paste the exact payload the TS client sends? curious if this is a serialization/padding issue vs model-side.

alex: sending a trimmed payload: `{"input":"hello","context":null}` — TS client uses binary proto -> polyfill fallback path when streaming disabled. Logs show `vector dims mismatch expected 768 got 769` from vec-store.

jon: My suspicion: batcher helper does a concat across shards and one path appends a 0 sentinel when an empty buffer is encountered. Quick mitigation: clip vectors on read when we know target_dim. Example: 
```py
def normalize(vec, target_dim=768):
    if len(vec) > target_dim:
        return vec[:target_dim]
    return vec + [0] * (target_dim - len(vec))
```
But this masks root cause. :thinking_face:

maria: Agreed — we should add this as a safe guard in the batching util but also fix the TS handshake. I dug into the TS side: theres a race during token refresh where the serializer gets a stray 0 byte appended when stream=false. Looks like an off-by-one in the varint length write.

alex: Nice catch. Can we add a unit test that rounds-trip TS -> py clients to catch dim mismatches? Also add an assert in rerank helper to surface a clearer error earlier.

sara: For rollout: let's avoid touching prod until we have the guard + test. If we want to hotfix quickly, deploy the guard on main, run canary against dedicated infra, then patch TS.

kevin: I can run the canary later today (window 18:00 PT). If we clip in the batcher, we should also emit a metric like `embed.dim_mismatch` so we can alert if it spikes.

maria: I'll open a PR with two commits: 1) add normalize/clip + metric + unit tests, 2) fix TS serialization (TS PR will be separate). Will link both.

alex: Ping @maria when PR is ready. I'll review the Python side. If tests pass and metric is added, we can merge the guard and run the canary. :+1:

ci-bot: PR #341 (maria/embed-dim-guard) — checks: unit-tests ✅, lint ✅, integration-tests ❌ (rerank_integration flaky) — details: https://ci.internal/redwood/341

maria: Re-ran integration tests locally with mocked proto — passing now. Flaky CI failure looks unrelated (infra timeout). Re-requesting review.

jon: Quick note — in rerank helper we also do a reshape that assumes contiguous dims. Add an explicit check: `if embedding_len != expected: raise ValueError(f'dim mismatch {embedding_len} != {expected}')` so caller sees a clear stack.

alex: Sounds good. Once both PRs are up, I'll do a light review and we can merge the guard. @kevin can you run the canary after merge?

kevin: yep, will schedule 18:00 PT canary on dedicated. Will rollback tag if embed.dim_mismatch > 0.

maria: PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/341 (py guard + metric), https://git.internal/redwood/pull/342 (ts fix). Adding e2e that uses both clients.

ci-bot: Branch build for 341 passed all required checks ✅ (all green).

alex: Great. I'll merge 341 in ~30m if no objections, then coordinate canary with @kevin. :shipit:

sara: Thanks everyone. Keep notes in the incident-runbook folder if we see spikes.

kevin: noted — will report back after canary.

maria: thanks all — will follow up with a short postmortem if we find root cause deeper than varint off-by-one.

alex: Closing loop here — will tag rollback SHA in the canary ticket.
